title: FA Cup semi-final draw: Chelsea vs. Leeds, Manchester City to play Southampton
content:
Chelsea will play Leeds United in the FA Cup semi-finals, while Manchester City will face Southampton.

Championship side Southampton are the only non top-flight side remaining, having defeated Doncaster Rovers, Leicester City, Fulham and Arsenal on their way to the last-four. They will play seven-time FA Cup winners Manchester City.

Manchester City have reached the FA Cup final in each of the last three seasons, defeating Manchester United in the 2023 showpiece before losing against the same opposition the following year and being beaten by Crystal Palace in 2025.

Pep Guardiola’s side defeated Liverpool, the 2022 winners, 4-0 in Saturday’s quarter-final tie at the Etihad.

Chelsea, who most recently won the competition in 2018 and who have been runners-up on three occasions since, beat League One side Port Vale 7-0 to advance to the semi-finals. They will play Leeds, with the two sides having met in the famous 1970 FA Cup final, which Chelsea won following a replay.

Leeds beat West Ham United on penalties in Sunday’s quarter-final after surrendering a 2-0 lead in second-half stoppage time as they progressed to the competition’s semi-finals for the first time since 1987.

The semi-final ties will be played the weekend of April 25-26 at Wembley, with the final scheduled for Saturday, May 16.
